DataDefinition.RecordSelectionFormula: {ROJ_MEL_DATA.CO_CODE} = {?Pm-ROJ_MEL_DATA.CO_CODE} and {ROJ_MEL_DATA.LC_CODE} = {?Pm-ROJ_MEL_DATA.LC_CODE} AND {ROJ_MEL_DATA.VCH_DATE} = {?Pm-@FromDate} AND ({ROJ_MEL_DATA.CR_AMT}<>0)and IF {?Pm-@DataType} = "C" THEN {ROJ_MEL_DATA.DATA_TYPE} = 'A' OR {ROJ_MEL_DATA.DATA_TYPE} = 'B' ELSE {ROJ_MEL_DATA.DATA_TYPE} = {?Pm-@DataType}
